newsitem.title: USA: Sun says dollar held back Q3 rev growth.
newsitem.headline: Sun says dollar held back Q3 rev growth.

text.p: Sun Microsystems Inc chief financial officer Michael Lehman said the company's third quarter revenues would have been roughly three percent higher if it had not been for the strengthening dollar in the period.

Lehman said in a conference call with analysts that Sun had double- and triple-digit year-on-year revenue growth in some countries in the quarter. But, in the sluggish Japan market the company posted a "slight decline" in year-on-year quarterly revenues.
Lehman said Sun is raising its quarterly production capacity on its new mainframe-like Starfire computer systems from around 70 in the June quarter to 100 beginning in the September quarter.
